values.note: Online through the Port Authority's RezExpert page ('Click Here for Online Reservations!'); changes and cancellations by phone, (814) 434-3078, 9 AM-5 PM. 'Reservations can be made one (1) year in advance from the check-in date.' No seasonal sites. Check-in 2 PM, check-out 12 PM. An early departure is charged up to two extra nights.

values.note: 56 campsites alongside Lampe Marina, all back-in.

summary: Added season May 1 - Oct 31, online booking via the Port Authority's RezExpert page up to a year ahead, water + 20/30/50-amp electric at every site, 56 back-in sites, showers/laundry/dump. Fees left as read 2026-10-13 (2026/2027 rate sheet). Phone (814) 434-3078 for reservations, 814-455-7557 Port Authority office; entry phone is blank. Not stated: sewer, max rig length, minimum stay.
flags: Ownership: the campground is owned and run by the Erie Western PA Port Authority (porterie.org, a public port authority), which under the curation doc's ownership rules ('regional or municipal authority') would be `local`, not `private`.

Waterfront claim: the operator calls them '56 Waterfront Campsites alongside Lampe Marina'; the entry is lakeview per the --AWH note ('fences and vegetation block direct access to the water'). AWH's firsthand call stands; noted only because a contrary operator claim is a re-audit trigger.
Price gate (information only, stayed-at campground with --AWH note): 2027 summer weeknights are $56 and Friday-Saturday $66, over US$50; May/September weeknights $51, October $38.
